problem_text:
A logistics firm must allocate its fleet to five distinct delivery routes, each requiring five sequential handling stages to complete a shipment.  
The revenue generated per ton of cargo delivered on each route is as follows:  
* For Route Alpha, revenue is 18.789 per ton  
* For Route Beta, revenue is 11.61 per ton  
* For Route Gamma, revenue is 6.157 per ton  
* For Route Delta, revenue is 11.404 per ton  
* For Route Epsilon, revenue is 16.322 per ton  

Handling duration required per ton for each stage is provided:  
* For Route Alpha, Stage 1 consumes 1.693 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 0.271 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 0.525 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 1.082 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 0.431 (ton-hours)  
* For Route Beta, Stage 1 consumes 1.768 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 1.882 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 0.775 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 0.983 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 1.203 (ton-hours)  
* For Route Gamma, Stage 1 consumes 0.714 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 1.174 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 0.562 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 0.734 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 0.995 (ton-hours)  
* For Route Delta, Stage 1 consumes 1.288 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 1.165 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 0.67 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 0.617 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 0.414 (ton-hours)  
* For Route Epsilon, Stage 1 consumes 1.61 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 0.378 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 1.519 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 0.648 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 0.712 (ton-hours)  

The cumulative handling time available for each stage is strictly limited:  
* Stage 1’s total handling duration cannot exceed 300.206 hours  
* Stage 2’s total handling duration cannot exceed 189.175 hours  
* Stage 3’s total handling duration cannot exceed 149.41 hours  
* Stage 4’s total handling duration cannot exceed 158.615 hours  
* Stage 5’s total handling duration cannot exceed 157.792 hours  

Provided that each stage’s total processing time remains within its allocated capacity, determine the optimal tonnage to assign to each route so as to maximize overall revenue.
